when: 장소와 인물의 관계를 처음 보여 줄 때
prompt: Camera: wide establishing shot, the subject small at a rule-of-thirds point, the horizon on the upper or lower third, the vanishing point pushed off to one side on a vertical third line, never at the center, with the subject standing at that off-center point.
Camera: full shot at eye level, whole body in frame, the horizon at the subject's eye height.
Camera: medium shot at eye level, cropped at the waist or thighs, with no feet in frame.
Camera: close shot at eye level, only head and shoulders in frame, large, with no legs or feet, overriding any full-body description.

when: 한 표정이나 사물로 결정적 순간을 찍을 때
prompt: Camera: extreme close-up, one face or key object fills over 70% of the frame and is cut off by its edges, with no body below the neck, no legs, no feet and no ground line, overriding any full-body description.

when: 인물이나 사물이 크고 위협적으로 보여야 할 때
prompt: Camera: low angle from near the ground, the horizon near the bottom edge, feet large and close, the body tapering up to a smaller head.

when: 인물이 작고 초라해 보여야 할 때
prompt: Camera: high angle looking down, the horizon near the top edge or out of frame, the head large and close, the body tapering down to small feet.

when: 공간과 인물 배치를 한눈에 보여 줄 때
prompt: Camera: straight-down bird's-eye view, the figures and objects laid along one strong diagonal of the frame.

when: 두 인물이 맞서는 긴장을 보여 줄 때
prompt: Camera: close on two faces at different heights, only their heads and shoulders in frame, the line between their eyes running on a steep diagonal for tension, overriding any full-body description.
